div.style: color: inherit
div.p: The question is answered positively if all components use schemas that are compatible with one another for producing and consuming records on the topic in Avro format.
If a component has integrated schema changes (e.g., a new message type version) and these are not compatible with a participant on the topic, the deployment is denied.
